1.text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by tha will of God, N Timotheus our brother,
2 tha saints N faithful brothers in Christ which r at Colosse: Grace be 2 u, N peace, from God our Father N tha Lord Jesus Christ.
We give thanks 2 God N tha Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, prayin always 4 u,
Since we heard of ur faith in Christ Jesus, N of tha love which y’all have 2 all tha saints,
4 tha hope which is laid up 4 u in heaven, whereof y’all heard before in tha word of tha truth of tha gospel;
Which is come 2 u, as it is in all tha world; N brings forth fruit, as it does also in u, since tha day y’all heard of it, N knew tha grace of God in truth:
As y’all also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is 4 u a faithful minister of Christ;
Who also declared 2 us ur love in tha Spirit.
4 dis cause we also, since tha day we heard it, do not cease 2 pray 4 u, N 2 desire dat y’all might be filled wit tha knowledge of his will in all wisdom N spiritual understanding;
Dat y’all might walk worthy of tha Lord 2 all pleasing, bein fruitful in every good work, N increasing in tha knowledge of God;
Strengthened wit all might, according 2 his glorious power, 2 all patience N longsuffering wit joyfulness;
Givin thanks 2 tha Father, which has made us meet 2 be partakers of tha inheritance of tha saints in light:
Who has delivered us from tha power of darkness, N has translated us in2 tha kingdom of his dear Son:
In whom we have redemption through his blood, even tha forgiveness of sins:
Who is tha image of tha invisible God, tha firstborn of every creature:
4 by him were all things created, dat r in heaven, N dat r in earth, visible N invisible, whether dey be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, N 4 him:
N he is before all things, N by him all things consist.
N he is tha head of tha body, tha church: who is tha beginning, tha firstborn from tha dead; dat in all things he might have tha preeminence.
4 it pleased tha Father dat in him should all fulness live;
N, havin made peace through tha blood of his cross, by him 2 reconcile all things 2 himself; by him, I say, whether dey be things in earth, or things in heaven.
N u, dat were sometime alienated N opps in ur mind by wicked works, yet now has he reconciled
In tha body of his flesh through death, 2 present u holy N unblameable N unreproveable in his sight:

If y’all continue in tha faith grounded N settled, N don’t be moved away from tha hope of tha gospel, which y’all have heard, N which was preached 2 every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;
Who now rejoice in my sufferings 4 u, N fill up dat which is behind of tha afflictions of Christ in my flesh 4 his body’s sake, which is tha church:
Whereof I am made a minister, according 2 tha dispensation of God which is given 2 me 4 u, 2 fulfil tha word of God;
Even tha mystery which has been hid from ages N from generations, but now is made manifest 2 his saints:
2 whom God would make known what is tha riches of tha glory of dis mystery among tha Gentiles; which is Christ in u, tha hope of glory:
Whom we preach, warning every man, N teachin every man in all wisdom; dat we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:
Whereunto I also labour, striving according 2 his workin, which works in me mightily.

2.text: 4 I would dat y’all knew what great conflict I have 4 u, N 4 ’em at Laodicea, N 4 as many as have not seen my face in tha flesh;
Dat their hearts might be comforted, bein knit together in love, N 2 all riches of tha full assurance of understanding, 2 tha acknowledgement of tha mystery of God, N of tha Father, N of Christ;
In whom r hid all tha treasures of wisdom N knowledge.
N dis I say, lest any man should beguile u wit enticing words.
4 though I be absent in tha flesh, yet am I wit u in tha spirit, joying N beholding ur order, N tha stedfastness of ur faith in Christ.
As y’all have therefore received Christ Jesus tha Lord, so walk y’all in him:
Rooted N built up in him, N stablished in tha faith, as y’all have been taught, abounding in it wit thanksgiving.
Beware lest any man spoil u through philosophy N vain deceit, after tha tradition of men, after tha rudiments of tha world, N not after Christ.
4 in him lives all tha fulness of tha Godhead bodily.
N y’all r complete in him, which is tha head of all principality N power:
In whom also y’all r circumcised wit tha circumcision made without hands, in puttin off tha body of tha sins of tha flesh by tha circumcision of Christ:
Buried wit him in baptism, in which also y’all r risen wit him through tha faith of tha operation of God, who has raised him from tha dead.
N u, bein dead in ur sins N tha uncircumcision of ur flesh, has he quickened together wit him, havin forgiven u all trespasses;
Blotting out tha handwriting of ordinances dat was against us, which was contrary 2 us, N took it out of tha way, nailing it 2 his cross;
N havin spoiled principalities N powers, he made a show of ’em openly, triumphing over ’em in it.
Let no man therefore judge u in food, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of tha new moon, or of tha sabbath days:
Which r a shadow of things 2 come; but tha body is of Christ.
Let no man beguile u of ur reward in a voluntary humility N worshippin of angels, intruding in2 dose things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
N not holding tha Head, from which all tha body by joints N bands havin nourishment ministered, N knit together, increases wit tha increase of God.
So if y’all be dead wit Christ from tha rudiments of tha world, why, as though livin in tha world, r y’all subject 2 ordinances,
(Touch not; taste not; handle not;
Which all r 2 perish wit tha using;) after tha commandments N doctrines of men?
Which things have indeed a show of wisdom in will worship, N humility, N neglecting of tha body; not in any honour 2 tha satisfying of tha flesh.

3.text: If y’all then be risen wit Christ, seek dose things which r above, where Christ sits on tha right hand of God.
Set ur affection on things above, not on things on tha earth.
4 y’all r dead, N ur life is hid wit Christ in God.
When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall y’all also appear wit him in glory.
Mortify therefore ur members which r upon tha earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, N covetousness, which is idolatry:
4 which things’ sake tha wrath of God comes on tha children of disobedience:
In tha which y’all also walked some time, when y’all lived in ’em.
But now y’all also put off all dese; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of ur mouth.
Lie not one 2 another, seein dat y’all have put off tha old man wit his deeds;
N have put on tha new man, which is renewed in knowledge after tha image of him dat created him:
Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, N in all.
Put on therefore, as tha elect of God, holy N beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
Forbearing one another, N forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave u, so also do y’all.
N above all dese things put on charity, which is tha bond of perfectness.
N let tha peace of God rule in ur hearts, 2 tha which also y’all r called in one body; N be y’all thankful.
Let tha word of Christ live in u richly in all wisdom; teachin N admonishing one another in psalms N hymns N spiritual songs, singin wit grace in ur hearts 2 tha Lord.
N whatever y’all do in word or deed, do all in tha name of tha Lord Jesus, givin thanks 2 God N tha Father by him.
Wives, submit y’all 2 ur own husbands, as it is fit in tha Lord.
Husbands, love ur wives, N don’t be bitter against ’em.
Children, obey ur parents in all things: 4 dis is well pleasing 2 tha Lord.
Fathers, provoke not ur children 2 anger, lest dey be discouraged.
Servants, obey in all things ur masters according 2 tha flesh; not wit eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearin God:
N whatever y’all do, do it heartily, as 2 tha Lord, N not 2 men;
Knowin dat of tha Lord y’all shall receive tha reward of tha inheritance: 4 y’all serve tha Lord Christ.
But he dat does wrong shall receive 4 tha wrong which he has done: N there is no respect of persons.

4.text: Masters, give 2 ur servants dat which is just N equal; knowin dat y’all also have a Master in heaven.
Continue in prayer, N watch in tha same wit thanksgiving;
Withal prayin also 4 us, dat God would open 2 us a door of utterance, 2 speak tha mystery of Christ, 4 which I am also in bonds:
Dat I may make it manifest, as I ought 2 speak.
Walk in wisdom toward ’em dat r without, redeeming tha time.
Let ur speech be alway wit grace, seasoned wit salt, dat y’all may know how y’all ought 2 answer every man.
All my state shall Tychicus declare 2 u, who is a beloved brother, N a faithful minister N fellowservant in tha Lord:
Whom I have sent 2 u 4 tha same purpose, dat he might know ur estate, N comfort ur hearts;
Wit Onesimus, a faithful N beloved brother, who is one of u. dey shall make known 2 u all things which r done here.
Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth u, N Marcus, sister’s son 2 Barnabas, (touching whom y’all received commandments: if he come 2 u, receive him;)
N Jesus, which is called Justus, who r of tha circumcision. dese only r my fellowworkers 2 tha kingdom of God, which have been a comfort 2 me.
Epaphras, who is one of u, a servant of Christ, saluteth u, always labouring fervently 4 u in prayers, dat y’all may stand perfect N complete in all tha will of God.
4 I bear him record, dat he has a great zeal 4 u, N ’em dat r in Laodicea, N ’em in Hierapolis.
Luke, tha beloved physician, N Demas, greet u.
Greet tha brothers which r in Laodicea, N Nymphas, N tha church which is in his house.
N when dis epistle is read among u, cause dat it be read also in tha church of tha Laodiceans; N dat y’all likewise read tha epistle from Laodicea.
N say 2 Archippus, pay attention 2 tha ministry which u have received in tha Lord, dat u fulfil it.
Tha greeting by tha hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be wit u. Amen.
